mismatches: The screw clearance voids (cylindrical cutouts) are not centered at (+-15, 0) as specified; the measured facts show they are offset to (±13.49, ±2.5).
The mounting holes in the base do not appear to be vertical through-holes aligned with the clearance voids, or the clearance voids themselves are misaligned relative to the hole axes.
summary: The part fails to correctly implement the specified screw clearance zones, as they are offset from the intended mounting hole centerlines.
